reason: I already take Toplux and reorder it when it runs out, and I forget vitamins half the time anyway. $29.99 is more than Toplux ($23) or Goli ($19) and those last longer, so I have no reason to switch.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli and they last longer. I'm not leaving something I already reorder for a brand I've never heard of.
would_change_my_mind: A price at or under what I pay for Toplux now, plus a free or very cheap trial box so I can try it without dropping money on it.
